source.canonical: https://www.sqlite.org/sqllogictest/ (Fossil); the git mirror is pinned by commit

scope: whole sqllogictest scripts covering table creation, insertion, SELECT, joins, NULL, grouping/aggregation, subqueries, ordering, and set operations; complete with setup statements; records conditioned on other engines (skipif/onlyif) are skipped as the reference runner does
exclusions: test/evidence/slt_lang_*.test: views, triggers, indexes, REINDEX, REPLACE, UPDATE, DROP, and SQLite-specific aggregate functions (total, group_concat) are outside the subset
test/index/{between,commute,delete,in,random,view}: DELETE-heavy or index-plan tests whose results are valuesorted (order not observable) or empty
test/random/*/slt_good_N.test for N >= 5 and test/index/orderby_nosort/*/slt_good_N.test beyond the listed ones: same generators, more of the same records; capped to bound per-round evaluation time

stages.description: IN / NOT IN with literal lists, empty lists, subqueries, and NULL operands (SQLite documentation evidence tests)
single-table SELECT with arithmetic, CASE, correlated scalar subqueries, aggregates in subqueries, WHERE, and ORDER BY over every column
multi-table joins in the FROM list with equality predicates; UNION, UNION ALL, INTERSECT, EXCEPT; IN subqueries over text columns
generated scalar and per-row expressions: unary/binary arithmetic, integer division, CAST, COALESCE, NULLIF, CASE, IN, BETWEEN, NOT NULL tests
generated SELECTs over three tables: comma and CROSS JOINs, DISTINCT, IS NULL / IS NOT NULL, COALESCE, aliases
generated aggregate queries: COUNT, SUM, MIN, MAX, AVG with DISTINCT, expressions over aggregates, CASE and COALESCE, over joins
generated GROUP BY and HAVING queries with aggregates and expressions over grouped columns
ORDER BY ASC/DESC with order-sensitive comparison over integer, real, and text columns; CREATE INDEX statements must be accepted (no observable effect); INSERT ... SELECT
